tagline: Digital transformation and IT consulting services provider
hero_kpi_rationale: Gross margin is the key KPI as it reflects the profitability of digital transformation consulting services, the core of Alithya's business model, with significant impact on operating profitability in a low-margin sector.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Revenues minus direct costs of services (primarily labor).
kpis.description: Gross margin increased modestly, calculated based on 2020 10-K data (Gross margin 82,974k / Revenues 279,007k = 29.7%), reflecting persistent profitability challenges in IT services.
kpis.signal: Stable gross margin despite wage pressure, indicating disciplined operational management.

kpis.name: Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total sales from consulting and digital transformation services.
kpis.description: Revenues reached $279.0M for fiscal year 2020 (vs $209.5M in 2019), demonstrating significant organic and inorganic growth in the consulting service portfolio.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by acquisitions and demand for IT modernization.

kpis.name: Operating Loss
kpis.explanation: Income before taxes and financing, after all operating expenses.
kpis.description: Operating loss amounted to $41.0M in 2020 (vs $13.1M in 2019), amplified by a $28.0M impairment charge following acquisitions. Excluding this non-recurring charge, the result would have been positive.
kpis.signal: Increased operating loss in 2020, primarily due to goodwill and intangibles impairment ($28.0M).

kpis.name: R&D Intensity (% of revenue)
kpis.explanation: Spending on innovation and development of digital solutions, estimated from base data.
kpis.description: Alithya invests in innovation but at a limited level compared to pure-play software companies, focused on automation and customer assistance tools.
kpis.signal: Moderate R&D, typical of IT services versus pure software vendors.

kpis.name: Goodwill
kpis.explanation: Value of past acquisitions recorded as an asset.
kpis.description: Goodwill stood at $77.6M in 2020 (vs $79.6M in 2019), reflecting acquisitions partially offset by a $28.0M impairment charge.
kpis.signal: Slight decline in goodwill despite acquisition-led growth, due to recorded impairment.

kpis.name: Total Assets
kpis.explanation: All assets recorded on the consolidated balance sheet.
kpis.description: Total assets reached $257.8M in 2020 (vs $236.9M in 2019), supported by growth in intangibles and goodwill from integrations.
kpis.signal: Moderate asset growth, reflecting expansion through acquisitions and consolidation.

kpis.name: Total Debt
kpis.description: Total debt extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Total debt of 0.12 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Cash & Equivalents
kpis.description: Cash & equivalents extracted from yfinance over the last four years.
kpis.signal: Cash & equivalents of 0.02 Bn € in the latest year

kpis.name: Revenues
kpis.explanation: Total sales from consulting and digital transformation services.
kpis.description: Revenues reached $279.0M for fiscal year 2020 (vs $209.5M in 2019), demonstrating significant organic and inorganic growth.
kpis.signal: Strong growth driven by acquisitions and demand for IT modernization.

kpis.name: Gross Margin
kpis.explanation: Revenues minus direct costs of services (primarily labor).
kpis.description: The 29.7% gross margin reflects profitability challenges in IT services but shows relative stability over the period.
kpis.signal: Stable gross margin despite wage pressure and integrations, a sign of operational discipline.

ai_positioning.summary: Alithya integrates generative AI and automation solutions into its consulting service offerings for digital transformation. It acts as an integrator and service provider rather than a developer of proprietary AI models, addressing IT and cloud modernization for its clients.
evidence: Strong revenue growth (33% YoY) driven by demand for digital transformation
Stable gross margin at 29.7% despite wage pressure, indicating valued expertise
Service portfolio focused on consulting, integration, and IT/cloud modernization
